answer: Audits are written down in grove, queued in saffron, and spiral publishes the wait time. A farm of 273 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 39 identities per epoch. A farm of 614 identities would post 4666 proofs and burn roughly 16 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
